question: Should this protected maintainer-owned Wave 1 type-contract cleanup proceed as the three proposed PRs, be narrowed, or be paused?
rationale: The issue is maintainer-authored, labeled maintainer, assigned, and spans scripts, gateway, and plugin registry contracts, so automation should not auto-close or queue it without owner intent.

options.title: Proceed with three PRs
options.body: Keep this issue as the tracking item and review scripts, gateway contract, and PluginRegistry cleanups independently.

options.title: Narrow the wave
options.body: Drop or defer one surface if gateway or plugin compatibility proof makes the first wave too broad.

options.title: Pause the refactor
options.body: Leave the current duplicate contracts until a concrete drift bug or maintainer capacity justifies the cleanup.

recommendation.title: Proceed with three PRs
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the tracking item and review scripts, gateway contract, and PluginRegistry cleanups independently.
